name: air_compressor_staging_comparison
title: Air compression: single-stage vs two-stage, isentropic vs polytropic model
summary: Air compressed from 70 °C and 2 bar to 10 bar along three paths — single-stage with 60 % isentropic efficiency, two stages of 60 % at an intermediate pressure of 5 bar (no intercooling, as in the original), and a single-stage polytropic model with 60 % efficiency — comparing outlet temperatures and specific works, plus the isentropic efficiency equivalent to the polytropic path.

authors: TBD (ULiège THD10 course solution; no author named in the file)
origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, THD10), session R05, exercise 2 (2010)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution (compare_solution.py, rtol=0.001, --ees-units): temperatures and works agree within 2.10e-03 (T_int), the works within 1.65e-03 (EES 8.4 vs CoolProp air cp). Absolute enthalpies (+1.259e5 J/kg) and absolute entropies (-1.815e3 J/kg-K), 20 variables, are excluded as ideal-gas reference-state offsets.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of THD10_R05_E2.EES (EES 8.423), 54 variables, of which 45 are common to the model
verification.notes: Max rel. diff 2.10e-03 over the 25 common variables excluding the absolute enthalpies and entropies (reference-state offsets); largest work deviation w_p 1.65e-03. 9 EES-only variables (cp, cv, R, p[1], p[2], T_s[1], T_s[2], s_s[1], s_s[2]) are dead data of the file, unused by its equations.
